title: Create account
wikitext:
Public Account Creation is currently closed.
We would like to make this open to anyone. But since we're understaffed and don't want the trouble of spam accounts, it will be kept an ''ask-to-get-an-account'' thing until further ado. We can create an account for you. Quickest way is to talk directly to {{player|bps|flag=se}} on [https://discord.quake.world Discord]. === Join Discord === Follow this invite link: [http://discord.quake.world discord.quake.world]
